title: Trickery TDM League Season 2
wikitext:
[[Image:Trickery.gif|centre|Trickery Logo]]
[[Trickery TDM League Season 2]] (TTDML) was a [[4on4]] [[Team Deathmatch]] tournament from the UK. Mainly classic UK custom maps were the ones played in the tournament, both division one and two had six clans this season.

* website: [http://www.daddied.com/ttdml2/ www.daddied.com]
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/ttdml #ttdml] ([[QuakeNet]])
* Maps: [[e3m1]], [[nbaseb]], [[ukqc1]], [[ukcldm2]], [[ukcldm5]] and in the 3v3v3v3 final [[titan2]]
* Date: Played between 31-05-2004 and 12-07-2004

== Results ==
* Winner: [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Dutch Hope]] - 21 points
* Runner-up: [[Image:flag_gb.gif]] [[Justified Ancients of Menace]] - 18 points
* Third: [[Image:flag_gb.gif]] [[Denial]] - 15 points
* Fourth: [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Eläintarha]] - 10 points

Division two

* Winner: [[Image:flag_gb.gif]] [[Funky International Pirate Superstars]] and friends - 19 points
* Runner-up: [[Image:flag_gb.gif]] [[Justified Ancients of Menace]] team 2 - 17 points
* Third: [[Image:flag_gb.gif]] [[Tortured Souls]] - 16 points
* Fourth: [[Image:flag_gb.gif]] [[Apocalypse 2000]] - 9 points
